hero.title: I build product interfaces with React and TypeScript, from Figma to production.
hero.lead: Six years shipping production UI. At Immfly I moved a legacy codebase onto TypeScript and a token-based Tailwind design system. Based in Barcelona, open to remote roles in CET.
proof.label: In brief
about.paragraph1: I'm Tiago, a frontend engineer in Barcelona. I care about interfaces that feel calm and obvious, and about the systems behind them: components, tokens and types that let a team move quickly without breaking things.
about.paragraph2: I came to code from working with people. From 2013 to 2017 I led a customer-support team of twelve, where I learned to listen before building, to prioritise, and to explain trade-offs to people who don't speak code. In 2019 I moved into software engineering.
about.paragraph3: I'm also studying Psychology at the UOC, which shapes how I think about attention, habits and the people on the other side of the screen. I work in English, Spanish, Portuguese and Catalan.
